orchestration_result.query: Build me a laddered bond portfolio for a 5-year horizon using investment-grade securities only.

bonds.analysis: To build a laddered bond portfolio for a 5-year horizon using investment-grade securities, we will distribute the allocations evenly across each year to ensure a steady cash flow and manage interest rate risk. This laddering approach helps to mitigate the impact of interest rate fluctuations by staggering the maturities. Each year, a portion of the portfolio will mature, providing an opportunity to reinvest at current market rates. Given the 5-year horizon, we will allocate 20% of the portfolio to each maturity year from 1 to 5 years. This structure ensures that no more than 30% is allocated to any single maturity year, adhering to the boundary constraints. The proposed portfolio will have a duration of approximately 3 years, well below the 7-year warning level and the 10-year maximum limit.

orchestration_result.final_recommendation: Allocate 20% of the portfolio to each of the following investment-grade bonds: 1-Year Bond, 2-Year Bond, 3-Year Bond, 4-Year Bond, and 5-Year Bond. This laddered bond portfolio will provide a steady cash flow and manage interest rate risk within the 5-year horizon, adhering to the 40% cap on any single asset class.
